prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create OBJECT 1 ONLY: one original unlit town street lamp, a standalone transparent pixel-art prop for Simple Life, a cosy farming-life RPG. This is one review asset, not a collection, contact sheet, scene or variant sheet.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is the approved planter bench: match its muted reddish walnut brown wood ramp, selective warm dark-brown outlines, restrained stepped shading and deliberate pixel-cluster detail. Do not reproduce its plants, seats or planter. Ignore any glow/background RGB visible around that reference.
Image 2 defines the orthographic angled top-down town camera, relative adult-character scale and welcoming outdoor atmosphere. Use it as guidance, not a source to copy exact lamp geometry or pixels.

OBJECT:
A slender straight warm walnut-brown upright wooden post with a restrained compact grey stone foot/base and one small enclosed lantern directly on top. Cream glass, UNLIT daytime appearance, no bright yellow light. Simple understandable joints: lantern socket attached to the post, post firmly seated in the low stone base. Modest shallow capped lantern roof with a visible upper surface, small readable frame around cream panes. No elaborate finials, curled ironwork, decorative brackets, chains or bulky ornamental construction. The long slim post dominates the height; the enclosed lantern is modest and the base compact. Believable public street furniture taller than the same adult farmer, roughly one-and-a-half adult heights. Do not include a character or ruler.

CAMERA:
Use the same room-aligned orthographic angled top-down RPG view as Image 2, with horizontal/vertical scene axes. The viewer can see the lantern cap's top plane and the stone base's upper planes; enough front-facing structure communicates height. Upright post and vertical frame edges remain vertical. No diagonal isometric rotation, perspective convergence, flat overhead or eye-level furniture illustration. All parts follow one camera.

STYLE:
Warm readable medium-detail pixel art matching the approved planter, never more realistic or intricate. Muted reddish walnut wood, warm cream glass and subdued stone greys. Clear silhouette, thin selective dark brown outlines, light from upper left, restrained 3–4 stepped shades per material, intentional clean connected pixel clusters. Very few purposeful wood-grain marks. Crisp pixel-art edges, no smooth vector lines, no blur or anti-aliasing, excessive grain, scattered texture pixels, glossy highlights, gradients, neon or thick black borders. Cream glass is a quiet opaque pixel-art colour, not emissive.

OUTPUT:
One complete isolated street lamp, centred on a portrait 1024x1536 transparent PNG canvas with generous clear padding and full cap and base visible. Keep proportions slender rather than widening parts to fill the canvas. Truly transparent exterior and clean hard edges. Absolutely no coloured glow, atmospheric halo, baked ground/contact shadow, background shading, floor, pavement, grass patch, display platform, flowers, buildings, scenery, characters, UI, labels, text or watermark. Generate ONLY this one lamp.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit ONLY this supplied street lamp. Preserve its EXACT design, silhouette, proportions, camera, arrangement, position, pixel detail and 1024x1536 canvas dimensions. Do not redesign, rotate, reshape, zoom, crop or change its stone base or construction.

Make only these corrections:
1. Completely remove every trace of surrounding glow, coloured halo, bloom, background illumination and soft shading. The outside of the lamp must be truly transparent, clean and crisp all the way to its silhouette. No ground shadow, no contact shadow, no backdrop.
2. Make the enclosed glass unlit warm cream in daytime. Use quiet FLAT cream colour clusters with just one restrained darker cream plane for material shading. Remove luminous bright ivory/white hotspots, internal glow, glossy highlights and all light emission. It should look like unlit cream glass panels, not a glowing light.
3. Slightly mute the orange wood into a moderately desaturated warm reddish walnut brown. Retain existing wood construction, marks, outlines and upper-left lighting; reduce orange and peach highlights gently rather than making it grey or dark.

Keep crisp pixel-art edges and selective warm dark-brown outlines. No smooth gradients, blur, anti-aliasing, extra textures or new details. One isolated complete lamp only, same size and padding. Transparent RGBA PNG, no characters, text, scenery, floor or extra object. This is a revision of Object 1 for review, not a new variation or collection.

Precise edit of this ONE existing lamp, not a redesign. Preserve exactly its outline, shape, geometry, proportions, camera, position, walnut wood, grey stone base and 1024x1536 canvas. Do not add, remove or move construction details.

Change only the enclosed glass panes to a slightly darker UNLIT warm cream with SIMPLE FLAT SHADING: muted beige cream front pane, one slightly darker beige cream side plane. No white or luminous highlights, no bright centre, no glass gradient, no emitted light.

Remove all soft glow, halo, bloom, background haze or soft shadow outside the object. Fully transparent PNG background right up to the crisp lamp silhouette, hard clean pixel-art edges. No scenery, text, floor or ground shadow. Keep the lamp itself otherwise exactly unchanged. One isolated revised street lamp only, for review.
notes: Approved lamp is reused exactly, including the user-requested final flat cream glass and transparency export. Earlier generated candidates remain outside runtime.
